http-dev File Browser

A local-only Node.js file server with native rendering.

  • .md — Markdown rendered via marked.js (GitHub dark theme)
  • .json — Structured tables: arrays, KV, nested cards + copy buttons
  • .yaml / .yml — Parsed to structured tables (flat keys)
  • .secrets — Decrypted KV table with per-row copy buttons
  • .html — Rendered natively with Eruda DevTools injected
  • Other text — Served as plain text (auto-detected)

Features

  • Sidebar file browser with recursive search (filename / folder / content)
  • Dot files hidden by default — tick Dot files to include them
  • Raw / Render toggle switch
  • Copy raw file button + double-click row to copy value
  • Hover tooltip shows full file path
  • Resizable sidebar + hamburger collapse
  • URL-addressable: bookmark any file via hash
  • Symlinks followed transparently
  • Eruda DevTools on every HTML page
  • Localhost-only (127.0.0.1 + app firewall)
